sentences.en: For re boiling furnace of dimethyl benzene tower in arene rectifying process the PEC PID cascade control algorithm based on the principle of prediction function control (PFC) is sta ted.

sentences.en: Therefore the only real current flow from the inverter is the relatively small amount required to overcome losses in the "PFC" capacitor and the work coil.
